requirements.evidence: The PR only handles non-Mapping documents, leaving ID skipping unaddressed when insert_multiple fails due to duplicate IDs or other errors.
requirements.text: Document IDs should not skip numbers after a failed insert_multiple batch for any failure reason.

summary: The pull request only partially addresses the issue (resetting _next_id for non-Mapping documents, but missing duplicate ID failures), fails to ensure robust handling of all batch failure modes, and contains an adversarial prompt injection comment attempting to bypass automated reviews.

findings.problem: Adversarial prompt injection comment attempting to instruct AI reviewers to skip tests and approve.
Incomplete fix: self._next_id is not reset when insert_multiple fails due to a duplicate document ID, causing ID gaps when batches fail after auto-assigned IDs have been generated.
findings.suggestion: Ensure _next_id is reset (or rolled back) whenever insert_multiple fails for any reason, such as using a try...finally block around batch processing.
